capabilities: Sync notes and images both ways with a Rizom brain
Mirror brain entries into vault folders by type
Carry renames and deletions through to the brain
Keep both versions of a conflicting note
Write brain templates, field definitions and table views to _obsidian/
disambiguation: Not an AI or note-generation tool; it only keeps the vault in step with a Rizom brain.
extras: The app password and sync record are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json; notes in custom folders, PDFs and canvases are not synced, and Obsidian's own settings are not synced between devices. Licensed AGPL-3.0.
problem: A local vault and a Rizom brain drift apart, and edits made in either place can be lost when the two are reconciled by hand.

relations.evidence: Notes and images go both ways between the vault and your brain.

requires.name: Rizom brain 0.2.0-alpha.769 or later with drive turned on

summary: Two-way sync between an Obsidian vault and a Rizom brain, covering notes, images, renames, deletions and conflicts.
